pages.title: Cyclone Power Drifter Electric Trike
pages.description: Get ready for high speeds as you indulge in 360-degree spins and adrenaline-pumping drifts, you can light the streets with the Xootz light-up electric trike! Perfect for kids aged 8 through to teens.
pages.ld_description: CYCLONE POWER DRIFT TRIKE: Get ready for high speeds as you indulge in 360-degree spins and adrenaline-pumping drifts, you can light the streets with the Xootz light-up electric trike! HIGH PERFORMANCE BATTERY: The 24V lithium rechargeable battery gives up to 1 hour of continuous fun on a single charge, with faster recharging, lighter weight and longer lifespan than standard batteries, so your little rider spends more time playing. ///LIGHT UP WHEELS: Experience the thrills of full 360 spins as you effortlessly drift around on the vibrant LED light-up castor wheels. The high grip footrests will help keep you grounded as you whizz around!TWIST GRIP THROTTLE: Enjoy smooth acceleration and precise speed control with the twist grip throttle, choose from 3 speed options and reach up to 16km/h. For added safety, the mechanical brake provides reliable stopping powerDESIGNED FOR AGES 8 AND UP: The adjustable, durable frame grows with kids, while the ergonomic bucket seat ensures comfort. Perfect for kids aged 8 through to teens. Product size: L86-111cm x W56cm x H63cm, Max user weight: 60kgAWARD-WINNING PRODUCT: The Cyclone Electric Trike has earned high praise, receiving multiple awards from BlogOn
